items.title: Apple launches fresh legal challenge against UK encrypted data access demand
items.description: The filing comes a year on from the U.K. dropping an initial demand for access to British and American user data from Apple.

items.title: Trump warns Iran talks are ‘last chance’ to end war — oil prices rise as Tehran denies negotiations
items.description: President Donald Trump has warned that the latest round of negotiations with Iran are the "last chance" to bring an end to the five-month conflict.

items.title: India to raise up to $3.3 billion by selling stake in country’s largest life insurer at 10% discount
items.description: Indian government plans to raise up to $3.3 billion by selling its stake in the country's top life insurance company.

items.title: Takaichi’s fiscal push could lift growth — and Japan’s already-rising interest bill
items.description: Japan is giving up revenue now in the hope that stronger consumption and a 370 trillion yen public-private investment will deliver faster growth later.

items.title: Saudi Aramco profits jump 33% in second quarter as Iran war squeezes oil supply
items.description: The results come as oil supermajors have reported blowout quarterly profits, benefitting from higher fossil fuel prices amid the Iran war.

items.title: BP profit more than doubles as Trump blasts Big Oil for ‘making too much money’
items.description: The result come after U.S. President Donald Trump lashed out at Big Oil for making "too much money" off higher fuel prices amid the Iran war.

items.title: HSBC pretax profit beats estimates, boosted by higher net interest income and fees
McDonald's is about to report earnings. Here's what to expect
items.description: McDonald's stock has fallen more than 11% this year, dragging its market cap down to roughly $191 billion.

items.title: Analysis: Federal Reserve may be pulled into Bessent’s effort to support Japan’s yen
items.description: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent wants to defend the yen without selling Treasurys into a sensitive U.S. bond market. The Federal Reserve could help.

items.title: Big Tech's Anthropic and OpenAI stakes are distorting the corporate earnings picture
items.description: If you were to strip out Big Tech's investment gains from private AI companies, the earnings story is a lot less bullish.

items.title: Palantir soars 12% on blowout quarter, with U.S. commercial revenue soaring nearly 150%
items.description: Palantir's second-quarter earnings beat expectations, and the AI software company lifted revenue guidance.

items.title: Palantir's Karp renews attacks on frontier AI labs that are 'trying to drug addict us'
items.description: Karp said Chinese models can't be blamed for distilling U.S. models when the frontier labs "distilled all the value of IP, everywhere."

items.title: Jim Cramer says the market has warmed up to Big Tech's AI spending. Here's what flipped the switch
items.description: Cramer said Amazon CEO Andy Jassy finally explained how Amazon's massive AI spending will generate long-term returns.

items.title: Larry Berg named next Major League Soccer commissioner
items.description: Larry Berg will take over as MLS commissioner from Don Garber next year. He will sell his stake in Los Angeles FC.

items.title: Snap's stock jumps 8% on earnings beat and strong sales forecast
items.description: Snap beat analysts' estimates across the board in its second-quarter earnings report.

items.title: Twenty five states sue Trump administration over latest global tariffs
items.description: Twenty five states sued the Trump administration, arguing its latest global tariffs unlawfully replace duties already struck down by courts.

items.title: Trump sours on Pirro over Reflecting Pool case, won't say her job is safe
items.description: President Donald Trump said Jeanine Pirro, the U.S. attorney for the District of Columbia, "choked" and "folded like an umbrella" in the Reflecting Pool case.

items.title: FAA clears smallest Boeing 737 Max to fly after years of delays
items.description: Airlines can finally start flying passengers soon after planes are certified, but it can take them months to work them into schedules.

items.title: Trump says Exxon and Chevron made 'too much money' off high oil prices during Iran conflict: 'I don't like it'
items.description: U.S. crude oil prices have gained about 20% since the U.S. and Israel attacked Iran on Feb. 28.

items.title: Amazon tops $3 trillion market cap as stock continues post-earnings surge
items.description: Shares of Amazon hit a new all-time high Monday, putting its market cap over $3 trillion.
